title: a background child on Windows starts through pythonw so no console host sits in its tree
intention: background_python on nt returns the pythonw.exe beside the interpreter when it exists, so a spawned background child owns no console host, and the proof says what a caller sees of it.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: tooth 2 of test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py reds twice alone: a console host sits in the spawned tree [conhost.exe parent = the base python.exe under the venv launcher]
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8: the console-in-tree claim was measured red and the fix is proven by the same measurement; Law 9: red is the default and tooth 2 stays the instrument.
how: In cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/windowless_spawn.py background_python, where os_name is nt and a pythonw.exe sits beside the executable, return that path; else return the executable as now (posix unchanged). Update its docstring: the old guess about base interpreters stays recorded as refuted, and the pythonw launcher exits at once so a caller must not track the child by Popen.pid or poll. Red-first proof cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_background_python_is_pythonw_on_nt.py builds a scratch dir with python.exe and pythonw.exe and asserts the nt result is the pythonw path, the no-pythonw case returns the executable, and posix is unchanged; tooth 2 of 0156856b1fae (the live conhost tree measurement) turns green and is cited by the PROVEME note.

clauses.claim: on nt, with a pythonw.exe beside the executable, background_pythonw returns that pythonw.exe path, and background_python still returns the executable
with no pythonw.exe beside the executable, background_pythonw falls back to background_python (the executable); on posix it returns the executable unchanged

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: tooth 2 of test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py reds twice alone: a console host sits in the spawned tree [conhost.exe parent = the base python.exe under the venv launcher]
measured.how: reran the proof alone on a scratch HOME, reading the census reruns of 2026-11-13

measured.saw: spawning pythonw.exe beside the venv python through detached_kwargs() leaves a tree of two pythonw.exe and no conhost; the launcher pythonw poll() is 0 after 4 s while the child runs
measured.how: scratch probe, tree read from Win32_Process 2 s after the spawn

measured.saw: 0156856b1fae (commit 6ea474469) already shipped background_pythonw(), which returns the venv pythonw.exe beside the interpreter on nt; ground_loop/cli.py, base/shim.py and bus_client/remote.py call it. So 96cf is proofs-only. background_python must keep returning python.exe: a caller that reads the child's output needs stdout, which pythonw lacks.
measured.how: git log -- windowless_spawn.py; grep -rn background_pythonw; read both docstrings
